cover_headline: Delhi Wakes to Post-Diwali Smog as AQI Hits 368, 15 Areas Turn Severe
facts: Delhi's overall AQI was 368 at 7 a.m. on Monday, in the 'very poor' category, with PM2.5 as the major pollutant
All 54 monitoring stations read above 200, 50 read above 300, and 15 areas were 'severe' above 400; Burari Crossing and Sonia Vihar topped the list at 441 each
PM2.5 near Akshardham reached 760.99 micrograms per cubic metre at 11 p.m. on Sunday — more than 50 times the WHO's recommended 24-hour limit of 15

end.headline: Delhi Wakes to Post-Diwali Smog as AQI Hits 368, 15 Areas Turn Severe
end.line: A day after Diwali, every one of Delhi's 54 monitoring stations read above 200 and 15 crossed into the severe band.
